ex.t: 30岁出头、性格开朗的安德鲁·雷诺兹以驾驶悉尼渡轮为生。

ex.s: Above all, I hoped he wouldn't assign me to work with the fiercely competitive, extremely serious fellow who always wore dark clothes and apparently had a personality to match.
ex.t: 最重要的是，我希望他不会把我分配给那个竞争心极强、极其严肃、总是穿深色衣服、而且显然性格也与之相称的家伙。

defs.def: a person that you work with or that is like you; a thing that is similar to the one mentioned 同事；同辈；同类；配对物

ex.s: Creative Workshops: learn basic repairs and artistic redesign of old furniture, while sharing knowledge and ideas with fellow volunteers,
ex.t: 社会与环境行动：通过创造力和合作帮助应对社会和环境挑战。

ex.s: If this fellow participant is going to eat more, so will I.
ex.t: 如果这位参与者要吃得更多，我也会吃得更多。

ex.s: While running every aspect of our own news station, kids and their fellow campers will create and host a broadcast airing each night at dinner for the entire camp.
ex.t: 在运营我们自己的新闻站的方方面面的同时，孩子们和营友将制作并主持每晚晚餐时播出的节目，面向整个营地。

ex.s: They often criticized their fellow scientists.
ex.t: 他们经常批评他们的同行科学家。

ex.s: Oh fellow men, when some day you read these words, reflect that you have done me no justice.
ex.t: 哦，同胞们，当有一天你们读到这些话时，请反思你们对我并不公正。

ex.s: Survivors of the D-Day landings continue to meet to remember the fellow soldiers and friends they lost that day.
ex.t: 诺曼底登陆的幸存者们继续会面，缅怀他们在那天失去的战友和朋友。

ex.s: This year, can pay all my fellow workers a decent bonus.
ex.t: 今年，我能给所有工友发一笔像样的奖金。

ex.s: It struck him that the other Chinese men in the photo did not care about what was happening to their fellow countrymen.
ex.t: 他突然意识到照片中其他的中国人并不关心同胞的遭遇。
